title: P29: room_avatar https not enforced at decode
description: protocol-06 §7.6 comments room_avatar as 'an https URI'. Readings: (a) reject non-https when decoding RoomMetaData; (b) decode any URI; the fetcher enforces https. Chosen: (b): rejecting would fail the whole component over one cosmetic field; consistent with mimid-1wgh.34. Whoever fetches the avatar MUST require https.
